items.label: Hand-Woven All-Weather Rattan
items.value: The patio set crafted from fade-resistant, waterproof gray PE wicker and a rust-proof steel frame, this set withstands sun, rain, and humidity. The removable gray cushion covers are machine-washable for easy maintenance, ensuring lasting beauty and durability.

items.label: Space-Saving & Versatile
items.value: The outdoor furniture set includes 2 chairs with hidden footrest compartments (stow neatly under seats when not in use). Use the ottomans separately or as leg rests for flexible relaxation. Perfect for balconies, gardens, or poolside lounging and other suitable spaces in your home.

items.label: Plush Comfort & Modern Design
items.value: The conversation sets with thick foam cushions and ergonomic design offer superior comfort. The grey wicker coffee table can serve as a beverage display area, and the lower shelves can also be used as storage space to hold your items. It can also be used for decoration, combining practicality with a minimalist style.

items.label: Quick Assembly & Heavy-Duty
items.value: Wicker outdoor furniture is easy to assemble with clear instructions. Each chair supports up to 350 lbs, and ottomans hold 55 lbs, thanks to the reinforced steel frame. Balcony furniture set with sturdy construction guarantees stability in outdoor conditions.

items.label: Complete 5-Piece Set
items.value: The 5-piece patio furniture set includes 2 armchairs, 2 ottomans, and 1 rattan coffee table. Store cushions indoors during heavy rain to prolong their lifespan. The unified gray hue adds contemporary elegance to any outdoor space.
